# 🌐 About
mangabeira.net is the personal website of Gabriel Mangabeira — Olympian turned Growth Marketing Strategist.
It provides insights, frameworks, and tools that merge AI, Web3, and data-driven growth systems.

# 🧠 Expertise
- AI-Powered Growth Systems
- Web3 Go-To-Market Strategy
- Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
- Attribution & Performance Measurement
- Marketing Automation & Systems Design
- Personal Branding & Content Strategy

# 🎯 Content Focus by ICP
The site targets six primary Ideal Customer Profiles:
1. Web3 Founders (Builder/Early-Stage Project Lead)
2. Web3 Growth Marketers (Marketing Manager)
3. VP of Marketing / Head of Growth (Hiring Role)
4. Web3 Growth Operators (Indie Builder)
5. Web2 → Web3 Transitioners (Marketer or Product Lead)
6. Consultancy/Agency Buyers (Founders, CEOs, Investors)

Content covers 10 Web3 subcategories:
- DeFi (Decentralized Finance)
- DeFAI (AI-enhanced DeFi)
- CEX/DEX (Exchanges)
- Stablecoins
- Wallets
- DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure)
- RWA (Real World Assets)
- Sports Tokens
- Analytics
- Influencer Marketing
